_meta.extracted_from: PRT SaveBanks logic: code==16 → Art=false; code in {24, 84, 85} → Art=true with 1 slot; code==25 → Art=true with 4 slots
_meta.description: Bank artifact-bank config — which bank type_ids contain artifacts and how many slots they have by default. The actual slot count is read dynamically from the bank content's n byte; this config only tells whether to parse as artifact-bank format.

16.notes: Cyclops Warehouse (Склады циклопов). Plain bank, only gold/monster reward.

24.notes: Derelict Ship (Ветхий корабль). 1 artifact slot, may be empty.

25.notes: Dragon Utopia (Утопия драконов). 4 artifact slots, may be partially filled.

84.notes: Crypt (Склеп). 1 artifact slot, may be empty.

85.notes: Shipwreck (Кораблекрушение). 1 artifact slot, may be empty.
